subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should OpenClaw support provider/model overrides for main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs, and which public contract should own that override?
rationale: Current code intentionally keeps `systemEvent` payloads text-only and the fix would add or change cron API, provider routing, heartbeat, persistence, UI/CLI, and session-state semantics.

options.title: Design explicit override contract
options.body: Add a cron-owned provider/model override shape with validation, persistence, UI/CLI/docs alignment, and proof that main-session state does not leak.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document that main-session system events do not select models and steer model-specific recurring work to `agentTurn` jobs.

options.title: Fold into broader cron schema work
options.body: Defer this decision to the broader cron schema and cost-control API work so model, context, timeout, and spend semantics are decided together.

recommendation.title: Design explicit override contract
recommendation.body: Add a cron-owned provider/model override shape with validation, persistence, UI/CLI/docs alignment, and proof that main-session state does not leak.

likelyOwner.reason: The current runtime dispatch and payload lines route most directly through recent cron refactor/history owned by this contributor.
